id: # Starter rows for a Nuxt or Vue repo (pnpm).

args: parser=exitcode -- { {{files}} | tr "\0" "\n" | grep -E '\.(vue|ts|js)$' || true; } | xargs -r pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings 0 > /dev/null
why: changed files pass ESLint, so a lint error never reaches main
the app type-checks on every pushed commit
the unit tests pass on every pushed commit
a merge-conflict marker left in a file breaks it for every reader
the gate configuration is changed by a human only, so an agent cannot loosen the gate that judges it
